title: Little Boy in Overcoat Riding Tricycle on Driveway, 1950 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A charming snapshot from May 1950 showing a young boy wearing a light-colored button-up coat and matching hat riding his tricycle along a residential driveway. Beside him is a trimmed lawn and house or garage backdrop with a decorative white gate/door, reflecting everyday middle-class suburban family life in post-World War II America.
